events.details: Defunct. Hi-Speed kept claiming 'Internet Service Provider (ISP)' services until the site broke in late 2023/2024, so the proposal's c. 2024 is promoted; the 2004 current date only marked the last dialup-era design refresh. site began returning HTTP 404; ISP status claimed until 2023.

refs.label: Dec 2020: live site still listing ISP services alongside IT/security work.
Mar 2023: site still live with the same ISP service claims (CDX shows 200s through 5 Apr 2023).
From 21 Oct 2023 the homepage returns 404; CDX shows a continuous run of 404s/301s through 2024-2025 - the site died between Apr and Oct 2023, i.e. effectively
